description: UN-APPLIED DRAFT PROPOSAL. The single CLEAR, reference-grade, strict-passable head from the verified-findings sweep: C.KGm.Acc.All (Allgaier Gambit). Graded CLEAR because the source is reference-grade — Hooper & Whyld, The Oxford Companion to Chess (first edition), entry 'ALLGAIER GAMBIT'. HEAD ROW ONLY — the King's Gambit Accepted family carries the distinct Kieseritzky sub-eponym (5.Ne5), not covered here. This manifest passes --strict (CLEAR only). fields.historical_notes: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ng5, intending 5...h6 6.Nxf7 - a sharp knight sacrifice. Named after Johann Baptist Allgaier (1763-1823), the first to publish a detailed analysis (fourth edition of his book, 1819). Dual attribution: the Oxford Companion records the line was played around 1780 by the Englishman Cotter, 'after whom it is sometimes named'; the name nonetheless stuck to Allgaier as the first to publish the analysis. Head row only; the King's Gambit Accepted family also contains the distinct Kieseritzky line (5.Ne5) not covered here.
